title: SeededPrTargets
description: Input for evaluation/tools/build_seeded_set.py (Issue #224): the PRs in one dedicated seed repository, and the must_find metadata for each PR's INTENTIONAL marker(s). See docs/eval-seeded-repo-based-generation-spec.md. Documentation only; not used for runtime validation.

repository.description: owner/repo of the dedicated seed repository, e.g. kuju63/vue-seeded

defects.description: One entry per INTENTIONAL marker expected in this PR's diff.

path.description: File path the marker/defect lives in.

occurrence.description: 0-based index of this defect's marker among all INTENTIONAL markers detected on `path`, in diff order. Disambiguates PRs with multiple markers in the same file.

rule_id.description: Snake_case defect-type identifier, e.g. vue_dom_based_xss_innerhtml. Never derived from svelte-seeded's SEED-nnn marker suffix, whose numbering collides across PRs.

line_offset.description: Explicit line count from the marker to the defect line, overriding the default scan-forward resolution (first added line after the marker that isn't blank/comment-only). Omit or set null for the default.
